AcknowledgeBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/acknowledge``: R3, the analyst acknowledges a boundary
flag or a band change. ``note`` says what was checked.
AcknowledgeBody.title: AcknowledgeBody

AcknowledgeResult.description:
What an acknowledgement answers (202): how many open gates of that kind
it decided; zero with ``replayed`` when they were all decided before.
AcknowledgeResult.title: AcknowledgeResult

AgentQualityRowOut.description: One agent's primary metric in the latest run of the week.
AgentQualityRowOut.title: AgentQualityRowOut

AuditRecordRow.description:
``GET /records?case_id=``: one record in the web's row shape
(``AuditRecord`` in ``src/frontend/src/api/types/analyst.ts``): ``by`` is
the actor, ``what`` the summary, ``at`` the append time.
AuditRecordRow.title: AuditRecordRow

ChainHead.description:
``GET /head/{case_id}``: the case chain's head, which a pack records so
it can later prove which records it was built from. A case with no records
has ``seq=0`` and the genesis hash.
ChainHead.title: ChainHead

ChangeTypeBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/change-types``: the analyst adds a change type (adds
only, D-03). The reason is recorded and needs 20 characters.
ChangeTypeBody.title: ChangeTypeBody

ChangeTypeResult.description:
What a re-tag answers: the case's change types and required-field count
afterwards, and whether it was already tagged (nothing changed).
ChangeTypeResult.title: ChangeTypeResult

ClauseDetailOut.description:
One policy clause as the system of record holds it: ``GET /clauses/{id}``
and each item of ``GET /internal/clauses`` (H4's input).

``text`` is verbatim from ``clauses.json`` (never generated, never
rewritten); ``source_ref`` is the structured citation an agent claim carries
and ``ref`` the human-readable one. ``provenance_kind`` says whether the text
is a seed verbatim quote or a declared synthetic stand-in (ADR-29).
ClauseDetailOut.title: ClauseDetailOut

ClauseSourceRef.description: A clause in the policy corpus.
ClauseSourceRef.title: ClauseSourceRef

CloseCaseRequest.title: CloseCaseRequest

CloseRequested.description:
What the close route answers (202): the request was recorded and sent to
H1. The case is closed when the outcome comes back, not before.
CloseRequested.title: CloseRequested

CommitteeQueueItem.description: A released pack in the member's queue with their own vote status.
CommitteeQueueItem.title: CommitteeQueueItem

CommitteeThread.description: A question thread, visible to every member and the analyst.
CommitteeThread.title: CommitteeThread

CompletenessBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/completeness``: ask the owner one round of questions or
proceed to review. ``questions`` are only read for ``ask``; without them the
questions the narrative agent drafted (and kept) are asked.
CompletenessBody.title: CompletenessBody

CompletenessResult.description:
What the completeness gate and the round answer (202/201): the decision, the
round it opened (``None`` for ``proceed``), how many questions it asked and
whether it was already decided so.
CompletenessResult.title: CompletenessResult

Completion.description:
Filled over required fields, rounded half up, as the server computes it
(the client never does arithmetic on these).
Completion.title: Completion

ConditionEvidenceBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/conditions/{condition_id}/evidence``: the owner's evidence.

The owner says in words what evidence they attach. (A document goes through
the case's own document upload; evidence is not read by an agent, so it is
text here.)
ConditionEvidenceBody.title: ConditionEvidenceBody

ConditionPatch.description:
``PATCH /conditions/{id}``: the analyst updates a condition's status
and/or records a note on the evidence they reviewed. A status change needs
a ``reason`` of at least :data:`STATUS_REASON_MIN_CHARS` characters.
ConditionPatch.title: ConditionPatch

ConfigDraft.description:
The section's server-side working set. ``etag`` changes on every write
and names the published version the draft started from.
ConfigDraft.title: ConfigDraft

ConfigDraftChange.description:
One change in the working set: ``path`` names a value, ``before`` is the
value in force when the change was made and ``after`` the one it becomes.
ConfigDraftChange.title: ConfigDraftChange

ConfigDraftIn.description:
``PUT policy/config/{section}/draft``: one change to add to (or replace
in) the working set. ``before`` is what the editor showed; the server keeps
the value it finds in the published version, not this one.
ConfigDraftIn.title: ConfigDraftIn

ConfigPublishIn.description:
``POST policy/config/{section}/draft/publish``: the version note
(``reason`` is accepted as a synonym).
ConfigPublishIn.title: ConfigPublishIn

ConfigVersion.description: One row of a section's append-only history.
ConfigVersion.title: ConfigVersion

ControlInput.description:
One control's rating as confirmed (or AI-proposed) for scoring.
A planned control must never appear here (rule 7); the engine does not
special-case it — it is the caller's job to exclude it.
ControlInput.title: ControlInput

ControlInventoryOut.description:
``GET /controls?version=&domain=``: a control inventory version,
optionally narrowed to one risk domain.
ControlInventoryOut.title: ControlInventoryOut

CreateCaseBody.description: ``POST /cases``: both fields are optional; the web posts ``{}``.
CreateCaseBody.title: CreateCaseBody

DemoUser.description: One person on the local demo picker (``GET /auth/demo-users``).
DemoUser.title: DemoUser

DemoUserGroup.description: The demo picker's people of one role, with the heading the page shows.
DemoUserGroup.title: DemoUserGroup

Domain.description: The four FFIEC risk domains (scoring v3 / design A §5).
Domain.title: Domain

EmptyBody.description:
``POST validate`` and ``POST submit`` carry no input: the server reads the
case. The web posts ``{}``.
EmptyBody.title: EmptyBody

ExaminerAnswerIn.description:
``POST /examiner/answers`` (service only): what H1 posts once the
examiner agent has answered and the citations were checked against the
chain. The question text is not repeated: S4 holds it.
ExaminerAnswerIn.title: ExaminerAnswerIn

ExaminerAnswerOut.description:
The examiner's answer, in the web's ``ExaminerAnswer`` shape.

``refused`` is true when the records do not hold the answer (or the answer
could not be trusted): then ``sentences`` is empty and ``refusal_reason``
says why. An answer that is not refused has at least one sentence, and
every sentence cites at least one record.
ExaminerAnswerOut.title: ExaminerAnswerOut

ExaminerPending.description:
``202``: the question is stored and announced; the answer is not here
yet. Read it with ``GET /examiner/answers/{question_id}``.
ExaminerPending.title: ExaminerPending

ExaminerSentenceOut.description:
One sentence of an answer and the audit records (by ``seq``) it rests
on; the web's ``{t, refs}``.
ExaminerSentenceOut.title: ExaminerSentenceOut

FastLaneBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/screening``: the analyst confirms or declines the fast
lane the screening agent proposed (R4). Declining needs a reason.
FastLaneBody.title: FastLaneBody

GapBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/gaps``: the analyst searched the corpus by hand and
found nothing for something the case needs.
GapBody.title: GapBody

GateWriteResult.description: What a gate-deciding route without a richer answer returns (202).
GateWriteResult.title: GateWriteResult

HandoffCompleteBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/handoff/{gate_id}/complete``: the proposals to stand in
for the failed job's output, and why a person is supplying them.

``output`` is the JSON an agent's ``accepted`` list carries: each item is one
of the proposal models the failed agent may emit. An empty list is accepted
only for an agent whose contract allows an empty result (the critic, the
watchlist, the policy-gap agent); the check says which.
HandoffCompleteBody.title: HandoffCompleteBody

HandoffCompleteResult.description:
What completing a handoff answers (202): the gate, the job it finished, how
many proposals were accepted and whether this call changed nothing because the
same output had already been recorded.
HandoffCompleteResult.title: HandoffCompleteResult

HandoffGateView.description:
One failed job waiting for the analyst: what failed, how, and where the run
stood. ``reason`` is the failure code and text H2 reported. ``raw_inputs`` is
what the agent was given (the context pack as the model received it; cut,
``raw_inputs_truncated`` says so) while the gate is open, ``raw_inputs_ref``
names the stored copy and ``raw_inputs_sha256`` is the digest the audit record
carries; ``raw_inputs_error`` says why there are none.
HandoffGateView.title: HandoffGateView

HandoffGatesView.description:
``GET /cases/{id}/handoff/gates``: the case's handoff gates, oldest first,
open ones and decided ones, so the page can show what was finished by hand.
HandoffGatesView.title: HandoffGatesView

ImpactPreview.description:
What publishing the draft would change. ``summary`` is computed from
stored data (never canned) and says, for every figure, how many cases it
covers and what could not be computed.
ImpactPreview.title: ImpactPreview

InboxRound.description:
One round of questions. ``from`` is a Python keyword, so the attribute
is ``from_`` and the wire name stays ``from``.
InboxRound.title: InboxRound

ItemDecisionBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/items/{item_id}``: one decision on one item.

``value`` is a control's replacement rating (0 to 10); a factor's
replacement is the pair ``likelihood`` and ``impact`` (1 to 5 each, an
extension the web does not send yet). Which decisions an item kind accepts
is the service's rule (clauses are accepted or removed, controls confirmed,
overridden or removed, ratings confirmed or overridden, critic findings
explained), because the kind is on the stored item, not in the body.
ItemDecisionBody.title: ItemDecisionBody

ItemDecisionResult.description:
What an item decision answers: the item, where it stands now and whether
this call changed nothing because the same decision was already recorded.
ItemDecisionResult.title: ItemDecisionResult

JurisdictionActivateOut.description:
``POST /jurisdictions/versions/{version}/activate``: the list that is now
active, the one it replaced and the change it announced. ``already_active``
is ``True`` for a repeat of an activation that had already happened (no
event is published again).
JurisdictionActivateOut.title: JurisdictionActivateOut

JurisdictionVersionOut.title: JurisdictionVersionOut

LoginRequest.description:
Credentials for ``POST /login``.

Exactly one of ``username`` (the web form's field; the seed id without its
``u-`` prefix) or ``email`` (the original contract field; either spelling
of the seed id) names the account. ``password`` may be empty only for the
local demo picker (see ``fcrm_identity.settings.IdentitySettings
.demo_login_active``); everywhere else an empty password is just a wrong
one.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

LoginResponse.description:
What every login-family route answers with.

The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie and never appears in the body.
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

OriginalValue.description: What a value held before the owner corrected it (the original is kept).
OriginalValue.title: OriginalValue

Outcome.description:
Four outcomes required by the brief; no fifth value, ever (rule: nothing
is approved or rejected automatically).
Outcome.title: Outcome

OutcomeAnalyst.description:
``GET /cases/{id}/outcome`` for the analyst, committee and observer: the
recorded outcome with who decided it and how, and the conditions it
activated. The PO reads a different, plainer shape from the same path.
OutcomeAnalyst.title: OutcomeAnalyst

OutcomeRecord.title: OutcomeRecord

OutcomeSet.description:
One round's tally result, as S5 stores it. ``outcome`` is ``None`` when
the round ended with no majority (ADR-31); nothing is decided then.
OutcomeSet.title: OutcomeSet

OverrideRate.description:
How often analysts replaced one agent's proposals: ``overridden`` of
``proposals`` (the evidence ledger's count for the agent).
OverrideRate.title: OverrideRate

OverrideRowOut.description:
One analyst override of an agent's proposal, in the web's shape.

``proposed`` and ``final`` are the control's rating, or for a likelihood
and impact override the inherent product; ``agent`` is the agent whose
proposal was replaced.
OverrideRowOut.title: OverrideRowOut

OverridesPage.description:
``GET /overrides``: the rows the web lists, plus the per-agent rates
the Assurance screen shows beside them.
OverridesPage.title: OverridesPage

PackAddendum.description:
An answered committee question, attached to the pack (R6); the pack's
content and hash are untouched by it.
PackAddendum.title: PackAddendum

PackArea.description: One scored domain: the L x I, control effectiveness and residual.
PackArea.title: PackArea

PackBuild.description:
``POST /packs``. H1 (service) sends the ``snapshot``; an analyst sends
only the ``case_id`` and is handed the latest pack.
PackBuild.title: PackBuild

PackCriticFinding.description: A critic finding and where it points (``CriticFinding`` in ``analyst.ts``).
PackCriticFinding.title: PackCriticFinding

PackPins.description:
The versions the case was assessed under (``PinnedVersions`` in
``common.ts``: display strings, not the run's integer pins).
PackPins.title: PackPins

PackScore.description: The locked score as the committee sees it (computed by S2, never here).
PackScore.title: PackScore

PackView.description:
``PackView`` in ``committee.ts``: a pack as the committee and the analyst
read it. ``status`` is derived by S5; ``addenda`` live beside the pack, not
in it.
PackView.title: PackView

PinnedVersions.description:
Recorded once per case run on ``case_runs`` and echoed on every
``ScoreRequest`` and the audit record for scoring (ADR-16 / design A §5).
PinnedVersions.title: PinnedVersions

PinnedVersionsWeb.description:
``PinnedVersions`` in ``common.ts``: the versions a case pins, in the
web's display form (``v3``, ``v14``, ``2026-06``).
PinnedVersionsWeb.title: PinnedVersionsWeb

PlannedControlBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/controls/planned``: a control the business plans but
has not built. It is recorded and shown and never scored (rule 7).
PlannedControlBody.title: PlannedControlBody

PolicyClauseHit.description:
One clause hit of a policy search: the verbatim text under the web's
name (``quote``), both citations, its place in ``corpus/<source>.md`` and
its scores. ``similarity`` is the fused rank-agreement score in (0, 1];
``vector_score`` and ``text_score`` are the two rankers' own numbers.
PolicyClauseHit.title: PolicyClauseHit

PolicySearchWebRequest.description:
``POST /policy/search`` as the web sends it (``{q, case_id}``). ``case_id``
is for the log line only: it never narrows or re-ranks a search.
PolicySearchWebRequest.title: PolicySearchWebRequest

PrecedentIndexRecord.description: One stored precedent as H4 embeds it (``GET /internal/precedents``).
PrecedentIndexRecord.title: PrecedentIndexRecord

PrecedentPO.description:
The closest closed case: its title, unit and closed month, and which of
its values may be reused. Never its outcome, rating or similarity.
PrecedentPO.title: PrecedentPO

PrecedentRecordIn.description:
``POST /internal/precedents``: the closed-case feedback loop (H1 posts one
when a case closes). Posting the same ``case_id`` again replaces the row.
``outcome`` is stored in the seed's vocabulary (``approved``, ``deferred``,
``rejected``) so closed cases and seeded ones filter alike.
PrecedentRecordIn.title: PrecedentRecordIn

PrecedentRecordOut.description:
What ``POST /internal/precedents`` did: ``created`` for a new row,
``changed`` when an existing one was replaced with different content;
``index_requested`` says whether an ``index.build`` was enqueued (not for
an identical repost). ``index_version`` is the precedent index version.
PrecedentRecordOut.title: PrecedentRecordOut

PrecedentSearchFilters.description:
Metadata filters of a precedent search; every field narrows, none ranks.
The date bounds are ISO dates (``closed_after`` inclusive, ``closed_before``
exclusive); the two list fields match any of their values.
PrecedentSearchFilters.title: PrecedentSearchFilters

PrecedentSearchRequest.description: ``POST /precedents/search``: closed cases similar to a case summary.
PrecedentSearchRequest.title: PrecedentSearchRequest

PrecedentSearchResponse.description:
Precedent hits and, per control, the mean rating over the hits that rated
it (``precedent_avg``: code, not a model, so the critic can re-derive it).
PrecedentSearchResponse.title: PrecedentSearchResponse

PrincipalOut.description:
A person as the web shows them: the login ``user`` and ``GET /me``.

``id`` is the seed id (``u-riyer``), which is the JWT ``sub`` and the key
every other service stores (``analyst_id``, ``owner``).
PrincipalOut.title: PrincipalOut

Proposal.description:
A stored proposal. ``seq`` is the case's own monotonic ledger number
(one sequence per case, so it is also monotonic within a run);
``superseded_by`` is derived on read from the proposal that names this
one in its ``supersedes``.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposalAppend.description:
``POST /proposals``: one validated agent output for the evidence
ledger. ``kind`` is open (``extraction``, ``category``, ``gaps``,
``screening``, ``research``, ``assessment``, ``critic``, ``narrative``,
``completeness``, ``examiner``, ``watchlist``, ``reflag`` ...) so a new
agent needs no contract change; ``supersedes`` names the earlier proposal
this one replaces (a later version is a new document: the ledger never
updates one).
ProposalAppend.title: ProposalAppend

ProposalTokens.description:
Token usage of the model call that produced a proposal (the keys of
``AgentDone.usage``); all zero for a proposal no model call produced.
ProposalTokens.title: ProposalTokens

PublishedVersionOut.description:
What a publish answers: the version now active and whether this call
wrote it (``False`` for a repeat of the same publish).
PublishedVersionOut.title: PublishedVersionOut

Recommendation.description:
``Recommendation`` in ``analyst.ts``: the narrative agent's draft with the
analyst's edits applied, the conditions, the outcome the analyst recommends,
whether it is locked and what still blocks the lock. Analyst only.
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

RecommendationEditBody.description:
``PUT /cases/{id}/recommendation``: what the analyst changed in the draft.
Each field is optional; an absent one is not edited (the draft stands). The
analyst's own edits need no reason; the lock and the unlock are separate
gates.
RecommendationEditBody.title: RecommendationEditBody

RecordAppend.description:
What the caller submits; ``prev_hash``/``hash``/``seq`` are computed
by the service, never supplied by the caller.
RecordAppend.title: RecordAppend

RecordedWrite.description:
What recording a planned control or a gap answers (201): its id and
whether the same one was already recorded.
RecordedWrite.title: RecordedWrite

ReflagAcknowledge.description:
``POST /reflags/{id}/acknowledge``.

``reason`` is the contract's name, ``note`` the web's; exactly one need be
given. ``rerun`` is the analyst's request that research (and assessment,
where the case's evidence depends on list status) be run again: it is
recorded with the acknowledgement and never starts anything by itself.
ReflagAcknowledge.title: ReflagAcknowledge

ReflagOut.description: One re-flag, the web's ``Reflag`` plus what an analyst needs to judge it.
ReflagOut.title: ReflagOut

RefreshRequest.description:
Non-browser clients may send the refresh token in the body instead
of relying on the cookie (design A §8.1: "cookie or {refresh_token}").
Not a shared contract shape (no other service calls this): kept local
to this package rather than added to ``fcrm_contracts`` on this pass.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RerunBody.description: ``POST /cases/{id}/runs``: re-run research and assessment, with a reason.
RerunBody.title: RerunBody

RerunResult.description: The re-run was requested (202); H1 starts it.
RerunResult.title: RerunResult

ResolveThreadBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/clarifications/{thread_id}/resolve``: nothing to say
but, optionally, why it is resolved.
ResolveThreadBody.title: ResolveThreadBody

ResolvedFieldSetOut.description:
``GET /field-sets/{version}/resolve?change_types=a,b``: the fields a
case with those change types must fill (the always-required set, then each
type's own fields in the order the types were given, de-duplicated by
field id). Each per-type field carries the change type that adds it.
ResolvedFieldSetOut.title: ResolvedFieldSetOut

RestrictedScan.description:
What the restricted-term scan found in the PO-facing business summary
(``restricted_scan`` in ``analyst.ts``): shown to the analyst, never the PO.
RestrictedScan.title: RestrictedScan

RosterUser.description:
One entry of ``GET /users?role=``: who can be assigned or can vote.

Deliberately narrower than :class:`PrincipalOut`: no title, no account
flags, never a credential.
RosterUser.title: RosterUser

RoundBody.description: ``POST /cases/{id}/clarifications``: open the round with these questions.
RoundBody.title: RoundBody

RoundQuestion.description:
One question of the round, as the web's composer posts it (``keep``
false drops it). ``anchor`` is the field or control it is about.
RoundQuestion.title: RoundQuestion

RoutingRule.description: One of R1..R6 as data (ADR-19 as D-19 origin; routing v4).
RoutingRule.title: RoutingRule

RoutingRulesOut.description: A routing rules version: ``version`` is the label cases pin (``v4``).
RoutingRulesOut.title: RoutingRulesOut

RoutingRulesPublishIn.description:
``POST /internal/routing-rules``: the rules version that becomes the
active one, under the same ``base_version`` rule as the model.
RoutingRulesPublishIn.title: RoutingRulesPublishIn

S5_PackSummary.description: One pack version in a case's list (``PackSummary`` in ``analyst.ts``).
S5_PackSummary.title: PackSummary

ScoreShown.description: ``ScoreBox`` once the analyst has started review: S2's answer as stored.
ScoreShown.title: ScoreShown

ScoreWithheld.description: ``ScoreBox`` before review starts: no number is sent (design C 2.14).
ScoreWithheld.title: ScoreWithheld

ScoringModelPublishIn.description:
``POST /internal/models``: the model that becomes the active one.
``base_version`` is the version the caller believes is active; S2 refuses
the call when it is not (a concurrent publish moved it).
ScoringModelPublishIn.title: ScoringModelPublishIn

SimulateRequest.description: What the analyst asks: which control, rated at what.
SimulateRequest.title: SimulateRequest

SimulateResponse.title: SimulateResponse

SourceRef.description:
A page:line pointer into a stored document; ``label`` is the display
form, e.g. ``business_case.pdf p.4 l.12``.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

ThreadAnswerBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/clarifications/{thread_id}/answer``: the owner's answer.

``documents`` are the names of documents to add with the answer (they go
through the same checks as any upload); ``field_values`` are values the
answer sets. Neither is required.
ThreadAnswerBody.title: ThreadAnswerBody

ThreadAnswerIn.description:
``POST /threads/{thread_id}/answer``. ``numbers_changed`` needs a reason
of at least :data:`REASON_MIN_CHARS`; without it the answer is an addendum.
ThreadAnswerIn.title: ThreadAnswerIn

ThreadFieldValue.description: A value the owner sets with their answer (``F11`` is now ``...``).
ThreadFieldValue.title: ThreadFieldValue

ThreadResolveResult.description:
What resolving a question answers: where it stands and whether it already
stood there.
ThreadResolveResult.title: ThreadResolveResult

UnlockBody.description:
``POST /cases/{id}/recommendation/unlock``: reopen the numbers, with the
reason that goes on the chain (R6).
UnlockBody.title: UnlockBody

ValidateResponse.description:
What ``/core/validate`` returns to nginx's ``auth_request`` and to any
service that falls back to it when JWKS is unavailable.
ValidateResponse.title: ValidateResponse

VersionsRowOut.description:
One pinned version of a case: what it was run against, what a case
opened now would pin, and whether they differ.

``current`` is ``None`` when S4 has no newer run to compare with.
VersionsRowOut.title: VersionsRowOut

VoteIn.description:
``POST /packs/{pack_id}/votes``. The member is the caller and the round
is the pack's current one; neither is in the body.
VoteIn.title: VoteIn

VoteOption.description:
Mirrors Outcome; kept distinct so a cast vote and a tallied outcome are
never structurally confusable.
VoteOption.title: VoteOption

VoteReceipt.description: What a vote returns: that it counted, never what it was.
VoteReceipt.title: VoteReceipt

VotesView.description:
The votes of one round. Until all three are cast ``revealed`` is false
and every ``choice`` but the caller's own is null; the reveal and the tally
happen together on the third vote (R2).
VotesView.title: VotesView

info.description: Every service of the api process under its public prefix (X1 /api/fcrm/auth, S1 /api/fcrm, S2 /scoring, S3 /policy, S4 /audit, S5 /decision).
info.title: TrustOps API

get.description:
Each agent's primary eval metric in the week's latest run (the newest
week when none is asked for). 404 when nothing was published: the web's
empty state.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No run for the week.

404.description: No eval run was published for the week.

get.description:
The latest published dashboard, self-contained, as ``text/html`` under a
strict CSP (no network, no script, no frame, no form).

Raises:
    NotFoundError: Nothing was published.

post.description:
Store H1's answer to a question. Storing the same answer again is a
replay (200, nothing written); a different one for the same question is a
409. The ``Idempotency-Key`` header is validated; the question's id and the
body's fingerprint are what make the call idempotent.

409.description: A different answer is already stored.

422.description: The answer cites a record the chain does not hold.

get.description: The answer to a question, or 202 while it has none.

post.description:
Ask the examiner a question about one case and wait for its answer.

The examiner answers only from the case's audit chain and cites the records
it used; when the records do not hold the answer it says so. The call waits
up to a minute, then answers 202 with the question's id.

202.description: Stored and announced; the answer is not here yet.

404.description: The case has no audit chain.

503.description: The question could not be announced.

get.description:
The last ``seq`` and hash of ``case_id``'s chain (``seq=0`` and the
genesis hash for a case with no records): what a pack records so it can
later show which records it was built from.

The analyst overrides, newest first, with how often each agent's
proposals were replaced (``overridden`` of ``proposals``). ``agent`` narrows
both.

One page of ``case_id``'s proposals in ``seq`` order, optionally for
one run, one agent and one kind.

post.description:
Append one validated agent output to the case's evidence ledger. The
ledger is append-only: a later version of a proposal is a new entry whose
``supersedes`` names the one it replaces. A repeated ``Idempotency-Key``
returns the proposal it already stored with 200.

200.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the proposal already stored.

409.description: The key was used for a different request, or `supersedes` already has a successor.

get.description:
One page of ``case_id``'s chain in the web's row shape (web path
``audit/records?case_id=``), in ``seq`` order, oldest first.

post.description:
Append one record to ``body.case_id``'s chain. The only chain write
route S4 exposes (design A §2.4; ``docs/governance/audit-chain.md``).
A repeated ``Idempotency-Key`` returns the record it already wrote with
200 and appends nothing.

200.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the record already stored.

409.description: The key was used for a different request.

get.description: One page of ``case_id``'s chain, in ``seq`` order, oldest first.

Recompute ``case_id``'s whole chain and report whether it is
intact, and the first broken ``seq`` if not (``fcrm_audit.chain.
verify_chain``, the only place a chain is ever verified). A case with
no records yet verifies trivially (``ok=True``, ``record_count=0``).

The versions ``case_id`` was pinned to when its run opened, beside what a
case opened now would pin. A case with no pins in its chain has no rows.
Alias of ``POST /core/validate`` (design A §8.1).

post.description:
The AEO contract kept for nginx's ``auth_request`` (``ops/nginx``)
and for any service falling back to it when JWKS is unreachable.
``current_user`` already rejects a non-access, expired or badly
signed token with 401 before this body ever runs (bug 1's fix, shared
with every other service via :class:`fcrm_common.auth.TokenVerifier`).

get.description:
The seeded people grouped for the web's demo picker. Unauthenticated
by design (it is shown before anyone has signed in) and therefore
available only where password-less login is
(:attr:`IdentitySettings.demo_login_active`).

Raises:
    NotFoundError: Demo mode is off or ``ENV`` is not local -- the same
        404 an unknown route gets, so the endpoint does not advertise
        itself.

schema.title: Response Demo Users Demo Users Get

post.description:
Password login for a seeded user. Rate-limited at the gateway
(nginx ``limit_req zone=fcrm_login``), not here.

The account is named by ``username`` or ``email`` (exactly one, see
:class:`~fcrm_contracts.api.identity.LoginRequest`). When the local demo
picker is on (:attr:`IdentitySettings.demo_login_active`) an *empty*
password signs the named, enabled user in without a hash check; in every
other environment an empty password is checked like any other and fails.

Raises:
    UnauthorizedError: Unknown login, disabled account or wrong
        password -- one message for all three, so the response never
        reveals which it was.

Revoke the caller's refresh token (if one is presented and still
decodes) and clear the cookie. Always 204: logging out an
already-expired session is not an error.

get.description: The caller's own profile (id, name, roles, title, unit).

post.description:
Rotate a refresh token for a new access token.

Raises:
    UnauthorizedError: No refresh token presented, it is not a
        ``refresh``-typed token (rejects an access token here, the
        mirror image of bug 1), it was never issued, is revoked or
        expired, or its owner is no longer enabled.

get.description:
The enabled people holding ``role``: the roster R5 auto-triage picks
an analyst from and committee release counts members against. OPA lets
analysts, committee members and the service account call it
(``permissions.json``'s ``identity-get-users-...`` rule).
Alias of ``GET /me`` (design A §8.1).
The owner's cases, newest first; ``stage`` and ``needs_response`` filter.

post.description: Raise a draft case: the id is minted and the versions in force pinned.

get.description: The case header, stage and what the owner does next.

post.description:
Acknowledge a boundary flag or a band change (R3): ``gate.decided ack`` for
every open gate of that kind, read from the score that opened it.

get.description:
The case's activity, newest first. An owner reads their own case's feed in
plain words (``PoService.activity``: only what the owner may see, no actor,
no audit record); an analyst reads every row with who did it, the audit
record it cites and its gate. Each caller's service is built only on its own
branch, so an owner's read never needs the analyst's stores.

schema.title: Response Activity Cases  Case Id  Activity Get

get.description:
The Summary tab: what the submission holds, what to notice, the critic's
findings, the completeness report and the score box. The score is withheld
until the analyst has opened the risk view.

post.description:
Add a change type with a reason (adds only): the fields and domains that
follow are stored with it, then ``case.retagged`` is emitted.

get.description:
The Inbox tab: the questions drafted for the owner, the round sent, each
question with the owner's answer, and whether the analyst's clock is paused on
the owner.

post.description:
Send the round the composer prepared: the same round as ``ask`` with the
analyst's own questions (one round, sent once).

Answer one question (text, optionally values and documents). The answer
that closes the round freezes submission v2 and tells Caseflow which fields
changed and which documents were added.
Resolve an answered question.

Ask for a delegated close (R1, Band 1-2).

Refused unless the case is open, the analyst holds it, its latest score
routes to the analyst (Band 1-2) and its recommendation is locked; a summary
that names a score, band or rating is refused too, because the owner reads
it. Asking twice with the same content is a no-op; a different second
request is a 409.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No such case.
    ForbiddenError: The caller is not the case's analyst.
    fcrm_case.errors.CaseClosedError: The case is closed.
    RuleViolationError: R1: no score yet, or the band routes to committee.
    GateRequiredError: The recommendation is not locked.
    ValidationError: The plain summary names a restricted term.

Ask the owner one round of questions, or proceed to review (D-16). ``ask``
opens round 1 with the questions in the body (else the drafted, kept ones),
pauses the analyst clock and emits ``gate.decided completeness`` and
``case.clarification_sent``; ``proceed`` emits the gate decision only.

get.description:
The case's conditions, soonest due first (one query on ``{case_id}``).

Role-shaped (ADR-30, one route, two shapes): an analyst reads
``Page[ConditionAnalyst]`` (above); the owner of the case reads the plain
``Page[ConditionPO]`` of :mod:`fcrm_contracts.api.case_po` (text, owner, due,
status, ``mine``; nothing about where a condition came from), through the
PO response guard. Another owner's case is a 404.

post.description:
Attach evidence to one of the owner's own conditions (allowed after the
case is closed): its status becomes ``evidence_submitted`` and FCRM reviews it.

Record a planned control (``case.control_planned``): shown and recorded,
never scored (rule 7): it is not a review item, so no score request holds it.
Discard an unsubmitted draft, with a reason.

get.description: The Documents tab.

post.description:
Upload files (multipart ``files``), or use the committed demo documents
(JSON ``{"demo_files": [...]}``). Each file is checked, stored and announced
to Caseflow in one transaction.

Record a policy gap found by searching the corpus by hand
(``case.gap_recorded``).

get.description:
The Handoff tab: the pack Caseflow built (id, version, hash, status), its
four release checks, the route and band, and who the committee is.

The jobs an agent failed twice on and that wait for the analyst, with the
ones already completed by hand.

post.description:
Finish a failed job by hand: the proposals the agent should have produced
and a reason of at least 20 characters. The output is checked like an agent's
(422 names each problem), stored, then ``gate.decided handoff`` carries it to
Caseflow, which resumes the run as if the agent had finished.

get.description:
The harness monitor: the case's run as Caseflow last pushed it (the agents
run against the 120k budget, the guards, the log, the chain check). For the
analyst, the committee and the observer; the owner never receives it (ADR-19).
404 until a run has pushed a snapshot.

The questions FCRM asked, by round, each "Re: <field>", with the owner's
answers. Nothing the analyst keeps to themselves.
The Overview tab: proposed types, values with sources, precedent, questions.

post.description: Answer the assistant's questions (one decision per question).
Confirm or remove one proposed change type (a removal needs a reason).
Reuse values from the precedent the assistant found.
Confirm or correct one value; a correction keeps the original.

Decide ONE review item (Gate A, rule 2): accept or remove a clause, confirm,
override or remove a control, confirm or override a rating, explain a critic
finding. An override, a removal and an explanation need a reason of at least
20 characters. The decision is stored, then ``gate.decided review_item`` is
emitted; Caseflow re-scores from the stored value when it changed an input.

get.description:
The recorded outcome. An owner reads their own case's plain one
(``PoFollowupService.outcome``: the label, the summary and the conditions in
words, no score, band, vote or rationale); the analyst and the committee read
how it was decided (committee vote or delegated close), by whom, why, and the
conditions it activated. Each caller's service is built only on its own branch.

schema.title: Response Outcome Cases  Case Id  Outcome Get

get.description:
The Policy tab: the clauses research proposed, each with its stored
verbatim quote and source, and its decision; the gap research declared.

The narrative agent's draft with the analyst's edits applied, the outcome,
the conditions, the lock and what still blocks it.

put.description:
Store the analyst's edits of the draft (narrative, outcome, business
summary); no reason is needed, the lock is the gate. Refused once locked.

post.description:
Lock the recommendation (``case.locked``). 409 ``gate_required`` unless
every item is decided and every acknowledgement given, naming each blocker.

Unlock with a reason of at least 20 characters (``case.unlocked``): the
pack is superseded and every item is decided again.

get.description: The Review & submit tab.

The Risk & Controls tab: the score of record by domain with the controls
behind it, the planned controls (never scored) and the critic's banner.
Opening it is what starts review: the case's own analyst's first read stores
the time, once, and the score is shown from then on.

post.description:
Ask for research and assessment to run again, with a reason
(``case.rerun_requested``).

Confirm or decline the fast lane the screening agent proposed (R4):
``gate.decided fast_lane_confirm``. Declining needs a reason.

get.description:
The case's live event stream (``fcrm_case.sse``): unnamed frames
``id: <seq>`` / ``data: {type, caseId, seq, at, payload}``.

``Last-Event-ID`` (or ``?last_event_id=``) replays everything after that
``seq`` from the activity log; without one the stream starts at the case's
current head. A PO must own the case (another PO's case is a 404) and is
shown ``po``/``all`` entries only, never score, harness or audit events;
analysts, committee members, observers and the service account are shown
the analyst feed too.

The case's frozen submissions, oldest first: every field with its value,
origin and source, and what a corrected value replaced.

What changed between two submissions: the fields (value and origin before
and after) and the documents added. 404 when either version does not exist.

post.description: Run the four checks again and submit; 422 names the failing check.
A dry run of the four submit checks (always 200).

get.description:
The case summary header: stage, strip, clocks, pinned versions and what
is owed before the case can be released.

patch.description:
Move a condition's status (reason of at least 20 characters) and/or record
a note on the evidence the analyst reviewed.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No such condition (or its case).
    ForbiddenError: The caller is not the case's analyst.
    fcrm_case.errors.ConditionClosedError: Closing is terminal.
    fcrm_case.errors.ConditionMoveError: Not a move an analyst may make.

get.description: The owner's KPIs and open cases.

The analyst dashboard: counts and averages computed from the stored cases
and scores, the viewer's own open cases and the seed's reference tables.

What was decided for the case, and how: the committee's tally or the
analyst's delegated close.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: The case has no decisive outcome yet (a round that ended
        with no majority decided nothing).

Every version of the case's pack, newest first; a superseded version stays
readable (both packs are kept).

The case's newest pack. A committee member gets the newest *released* one;
a pack not yet released is the analyst's alone.

Released packs that are still the case's current one, newest first, each
with the caller's own vote status and how many have voted (never how). One
aggregation: no query per pack.

post.description:
Record an outcome people decided and announce it (``outcome.set``).

``committee``: the pack's decisive tally, exactly. ``delegated``: an
analyst's Band 1-2 close with a reason (R1); never over an open committee
pack, never over an existing outcome.

H1 (service): freeze ``snapshot`` as the case's next pack, 201, or hand
back the live pack when the content is the same, 200. Building never
releases. An analyst: the case's latest pack, 200, or 409 when none has
been built (it is built when the recommendation is locked).

get.description: A pack by id, with its addenda.

The pack's latest round result.

Raises:
    NotTalliedError: No round has been tallied yet (409): there is no
        outcome to read, and none is ever invented.

post.description:
Release the pack to the committee (the ``pack_release`` gate).

409 unless all four release checks passed, naming the ones that did not;
the committee roster comes from X1. Releasing an already released pack is
a no-op that announces nothing a second time.

Confirm the re-vote round after a 1-1-1 split (ADR-08, ADR-31). S5 opened
the round when it tallied the split; this reports which round it is and who
is asked to vote again, and writes nothing. 409 unless the previous round
ended with no majority.

Supersede the pack after the analyst unlocked it (R6): it takes no more
votes, its cast votes are voided (kept, never deleted) and re-requested for
the next version, and ``pack.superseded`` (plus ``vote.rerequested``) goes
out. 409 once the pack has an outcome.

get.description:
The pack's question threads, oldest first: visible to every member and the
analyst (R6).

post.description: Open a question thread on a released pack, in the caller's own name.

get.description:
One round's votes (the current one unless ``round`` is given).

Until the round is tallied ``revealed`` is false and every member's choice
but the caller's own is null: the choices are not sent, not merely hidden.
A tallied round (including one that ended with no majority) shows every
vote and its rationale together with the tally.

post.description:
Cast the caller's vote in the pack's current round.

The member is the verified caller, so no token can vote in another member's
name and one-vote-per-member binds to real identity; a rationale is
required on every vote (R2). The receipt says that the vote counted, never
what it was: the choice is hidden until all three are in, and the member who
casts the third finds the revealed round on their next read.

Answer a committee question, in the caller's own name (R6).

Unchanged numbers: the answer is attached as a pack addendum and the pack's
``content_hash`` stays exactly as it was. Changed numbers: the contract
already required an ``unlock_reason`` of at least 20 characters; the pack
stops taking votes at once and ``committee.answered`` tells H1, which
drives the supersede, the corrected pack and the re-vote.

get.description: The owner's integrations and their choices.

post.description: Connect an integration to a location or channel, or disconnect it.

get.description:
One clause: verbatim text, ``ref`` and structured ``source_ref``, page
and lines, provenance. ``corpus_version`` pins a version (the latest when
omitted).

One section: the data in force, its append-only version history, and
the server-side draft with its ETag.

Response Delete Draft Config  Section  Draft Delete

Add one change to the section's working set (a change back to the
published value removes it). 409 when ``If-Match`` is stale or the
published version moved under the draft; 422 naming the field when the path
or the value does not suit the section.

schema.title: Response Put Draft Config  Section  Draft Put

What publishing would change, replayed from stored data: nothing is
written, and anything the data cannot answer is said to be not computable.

Append the draft as the section's next immutable snapshot and put it
into force; the version note must be at least 20 characters. The jurisdiction
list publishes by activating the stored list, with its
``jurisdiction.list_published`` event, in the same transaction.

schema.title: Response Publish Draft Config  Section  Draft Publish Post

get.description:
One control-inventory version (``v9`` or ``9``; the active one when
omitted), optionally only the controls of one risk ``domain``.
Every stored control-inventory version, the active one flagged.
One field-set version (``v6`` or ``6``; ``latest`` is the active one).

The fields a case with ``change_types`` must fill at this field-set
version: always-required first, then each type's own fields in the order
given (the same arithmetic as S1's ``resolve_required_fields``).

One page of a corpus version's clauses in id order (the latest version
when ``corpus_version`` is omitted): the records H4 embeds into
``policy_clauses``. Follow ``next_cursor`` until it is ``None``.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: The corpus is empty or holds no such version.

The versions a case created now pins (the service account's: S1 and H1
read it when a case opens). A publish moves what the next case pins and
never what an open case pinned.

One page of the stored precedents in case-id order: the records H4
embeds into ``precedent_cases``.

post.description:
Add a closed case to the precedents (H1 posts one on ``case.closed``).

The row and the ``index.build`` request for ``precedent_cases`` are
written in one transaction. Posting a case again is idempotent: an
identical repost is a 200 that changes and enqueues nothing; a new case is
a 201.

get.description:
One jurisdiction list: ``version`` is a version id (``v2026-06``),
``latest``/``current`` or none for the active list, or ``fixture`` for the
synthetic re-flag list.
Every stored jurisdiction list version, the active one flagged.

post.description:
Make a stored jurisdiction list the active one (the analyst only: the
service account never decides this). The previous list is deactivated and
``jurisdiction.list_published`` is announced in the same transaction, which
is what starts the watchlist run. ``version`` is a version id
(``v2026-10-fixture``) or ``fixture``; activating the list that is already
active is a no-op that announces nothing.

Search the policy corpus for ``body.q`` (design A §6.2). The web reaches
the same search at ``POST /search`` (its ``policy.search`` path on this
service's prefix), which tells the two request shapes apart.

Closed cases similar to ``body.query`` under its filters, with each
one's control ratings and the mean rating per control (``precedent_avg``).

Hybrid search over one of the three indexes (``policy_clauses``,
``precedent_cases``, ``controls``): rank fusion of a keyword ranking
(Mongo ``$text``) and, for ``policy_clauses``, H4's semantic ranking,
with the Index Contract's metadata filters pushed down to both.

A body of the web's shape (``{q, case_id}``) is the web's policy search
and is answered in its shape: clause hits with their verbatim text.

get.description:
The analyst's queue, the cases that need them first. ``scope`` is the
analyst's own, everyone's or the unassigned; ``stage`` and ``band`` filter
(the band of the latest score; a closed case is listed only for
``stage=closed``).
The watchlist re-flags, newest first, acknowledged ones included.

post.description:
Acknowledge one re-flag with a reason of at least 20 characters.

The decision is stored and ``gate.decided`` (``reflag_ack``) is emitted in
the same transaction; H1 then records ``reflag.acknowledged``. The same
acknowledgement again changes nothing.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No such re-flag.
    fcrm_case.reflag_store.ReflagAlreadyAcknowledgedError: It was
        acknowledged with a different reason.

Make ``body.model`` the active scoring model, if ``body.base_version`` is
the one active now (409 otherwise) and the model is valid (422). A repeat of
a publish that already happened answers the same version with
``created: false``.

Make ``body.routing`` the active routing rules, under the same
``base_version`` and repeat rules as :func:`publish_model`.

get.description: The scoring model version currently active for new scoring calls.

A pinned scoring model version, for replaying an older case's
score exactly (every case pins the version it was scored with).

One routing rules version (``v4`` or ``4``; ``active`` for the one in
force): R1 to R6 as ``{id, rule}`` rows, the parameter table and the
committee quorum.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: There is no such version.
The routing rules version currently active (R1-R6, D-19).

post.description:
Compute a composite score. Idempotent and pure given the same
``body`` and the active model matching ``body.scoring_v`` — called by
H1 after assessment proposals land, by the review-item override path,
and by nothing else (design A §3.1; ADR-07: no agent calls this).

What the case would score with one control at ``value``: both scores of
the control's domain and of the composite, each with its band and boundary
flag. The analyst's preview before an override; it stores nothing, decides
nothing, and is the engine that scores the case of record over S1's current
inputs (a planned control is never among them, rule 7).
